faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact us or ask Droid on Telegram.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse the store here or in The IDEA app, then add items to your cart and check out in the app. You need an IDEA account to order.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely by Wayl, which supports local payment methods. Your order is confirmed once the payment succeeds.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver to all 19 governorates of Iraq. The delivery fee, if any, is shown at checkout before you pay.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, under the conditions in our refund and returns policy. Contact us from your order in the app or by email.

items.question: How does IDEA Plus work?
items.answer: You subscribe to a monthly plan. Each plan lets you keep a number of items at a time. Request a game, book or movie in the app, we deliver it, and when you're done you return it and request the next one.

items.question: Can I buy from the Megastore without a membership?
items.answer: Absolutely. The Megastore is open to everyone; IDEA Plus is only needed for rentals.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: You can cancel your membership from your account in the app. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Please return any rented items.

items.question: Do I need a separate account for each service?
items.answer: No. One IDEA account works across the store, IDEA Plus, events, the journal and IDEA Suite.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: You can delete your account from the app's settings. Some records, such as invoices, are kept as the law requires.
